steps.en: Clone and install it, and export a model API key
steps.zh: clone 并安装，导出模型 API 密钥

steps.en: Run the review and triage graph over your source tree
steps.zh: 对你的代码树运行审查加分诊流程

steps.en: Loads your SECURITY and threat-model files as review scope
steps.zh: 把你的 SECURITY 和威胁模型文件读进来，作为审查范围

steps.en: Splits code with tree-sitter; the LLM reviews each part, plus reachability for C/C++
steps.zh: 用 tree-sitter 切分代码，让模型逐块审查，C/C++ 另做可达性分析

steps.en: Re-checks each finding against nearby code and writes SARIF/JSON with a verdict
steps.zh: 对照周边代码复核每条发现，写出带结论的 SARIF/JSON

steps.en: Read the explanations and mitigations, and fix the real bugs
steps.zh: 读原因说明和修复建议，修掉真正的漏洞

value.en: A deep first-pass security audit of a large codebase, with findings already filtered for false positives
value.zh: 对大型代码库做一遍深入的安全初审，误报已先过滤一轮

sources: https://github.com/arm/metis README (Installation: uv pip install .; OPENAI_API_KEY; Run Analysis: uv run metis --codebase-path "/path/to/src" --verbose; init loads SECURITY.* / threat-model files; review_code: simple LLM + CodeGraph Reachability for C/C++; example output Why/Mitigation/Confidence)
https://github.com/arm/metis/blob/main/docs/triage-flow.md (evidence collection, structured valid/invalid/inconclusive decision, SARIF annotation)
